subject: Mapping CAIQ A2 to inference-kernel telemetry — evidence delivery
messages:
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@tidebank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@tidebank.com
Date: 2026-09-05T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ: A2 - inference kernel telemetry artifacts request

Hi Irene,

As part of Tidebank's CAIQ submission we're mapping control A2 (Audit Logging / Telemetry) to the inference runtime. The assessor has asked for artifacts that show kernel-level telemetry and routing decisions that relate to model selection, quantization fallbacks, and KV cache behavior. Specifically we'd like:

- A sample of kernel-level traces (sanitized) showing kernel selection events (including kernel_id, model_id, sequence length, quantization_flag, timestamp).
- KV cache hit/miss logs for a sample window (CSV/JSONL).
- Model-variant routing logs that show fallback/rollout decisions and the reason codes.
- A short explanation of retention and chain-of-custody for these logs (where they live, retention policy, who has access).

Delivery constraints: prefer zipped JSONL or CSV samples covering ~7 days, up to ~2k lines per artifact. We need the artifacts by 2026-09-12 to feed into the CAIQ package. Please let me know if we should accept redacted samples or if you need an NDA amendment.

Thanks — Alice
Alice Jenkins
Security Engineer, Tidebank
security@tidebank.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@tidebank.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: A2 - inference kernel telemetry artifacts request

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide sanitized samples and a short artifact index that maps each item to the relevant CAIQ assertion. A couple quick clarifying questions so we scope correctly:

1) Time window: do you want the last 7 days (recommended) or a custom date range?
2) Raw traces vs. pre-aggregated: we can provide both a raw trace sample (with request identifiers hashed) and an aggregated summary (counts, percentiles). Which is preferred by your assessor?

Planned deliverables (proposed):
- redacted_kernel_traces_2000_lines.jsonl (sample raw traces, hashed request ids)
- kv-cache-hits-sample.jsonl.gz (sample of cache hit/miss events)
- ca iq_a2_artifact_index.csv (mapping of file -> CAIQ subcontrol)
- short write-up on retention and access controls

We can deliver by EOD 2026-09-11 if that works. David and Marissa are looped in to prepare the artifacts; David will confirm technical details on the traces.

Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ: A2 - inference kernel telemetry artifacts request

Irene / Marissa — tagging the artifact inventory and recommended redaction steps. Below are the artifacts we can produce and the sanitization we will apply. All artifacts live in the telemetry bucket under a scoped prefix; for external delivery we’ll generate a time-limited, pre-signed bundle and a Drive link for the index.

Available artifacts (examples):
- inference_kernel_traces_2026-08-sample.jsonl.gz (fields: timestamp, kernel_id, model_id, seq_len, quantization_flag, latency_ms, request_id_hash, reason_code)
- kv-cache-hits-sample.jsonl.gz (fields: timestamp, model_id, key_hash, hit_boolean, cache_latency_ms)
- model_variant_routing_log.csv (fields: timestamp, request_id_hash, source_region, chosen_variant, fallback_reason)

Sanitization plan: replace request_id with a one-way hash prefix (8 chars), strip prompt/response tokens, remove any customer PII, and sample to 2k lines per artifact.

Retention/ownership notes:
- Logs stored: s3://redwood-prod-telemetry/caiq-samples/tidebank-2026-08/
- Retention policy: default telemetry retention is 90 days; artifacts extracted for CAIQ are marked and exported with a 30-day signed-link lifespan.
- Access: only compliance and eng-sre groups have read access to the raw bucket; exported samples are scoped to a signed URL.

Attachments (internal): inference_kernel_telemetry_guide.pdf (internal guide for field descriptions), kv-cache-hits-sample.jsonl.gz (sanitized sample). I will stage the customer-facing bundle after Irene gives the go-ahead on redaction level.

-David

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@tidebank.com>, security@tidebank.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: A2 - inference kernel telemetry artifacts request

Hi Alice / Tidebank Security Team — attached are the sanitized artifacts we discussed and a short index that maps each file to the relevant CAIQ sub-control for A2. Links and attachments:

- Redacted traces: redacted_kernel_traces_2000_lines.jsonl (attached)
- KV cache sample: kv-cache-hits-sample.jsonl.gz (attached)
- Artifact index: ca iq_a2_artifact_index.csv (attached)
- Internal field guide (for reference): inference_kernel_telemetry_guide.pdf (attached)

Delivery method: a pre-signed S3 bundle is available at: https://s3.redwood.ai/presigned/ca iq-tidebank-2026-09?expires=2026-09-12T15:22:00Z (link valid 7 days). We removed prompt/response tokens and replaced request identifiers with an 8-character hash prefix as described below each file. The samples are representative (2k lines each maximum) and include model_id -> kernel_id mappings.

Retention & chain-of-custody summary: exported artifact bundles are generated from the production telemetry bucket under an export job that is logged and audited. Export logs and the job run id are included in the artifact index. Redwood's default telemetry retention is 90 days; CAIQ-extracted bundles are accessible to recipients for 7 days via signed link and are logged for the audit trail.

If you'd like a short walkthrough of the fields (15–30 minutes) we can schedule a session next week — David can join to answer kernel-level questions. Proposed windows: 2026-09-09 10:00–11:00 PDT or 2026-09-10 14:00–15:00 PDT. Please confirm which works for you.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs: redacted_kernel_traces_2000_lines.jsonl, kv-cache-hits-sample.jsonl.gz, ca iq_a2_artifact_index.csv, inference_kernel_telemetry_guide.pdf]

From: Security Team <security@tidebank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@tidebank.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T07:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: A2 - inference kernel telemetry artifacts request

Thanks Irene — we received the bundle and were able to download the samples. A couple quick clarifications from the assessor:

1) Are kernel_id values stable across minor model releases (or do they rotate)? We need to map kernel_id -> model_version for the CAIQ narrative.
2) Can you include a short matrix that maps model_id and common kernel variants to the RVA (runtime variant annotations) used in your routing logs?

We can do the walkthrough on 2026-09-09 10:00 PDT — please confirm David's availability. Also, can you confirm the pre-signed link expiry so we can ensure the assessor can retrieve artifacts before the window closes?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Tidebank Security Team
security@tidebank.com
